entries.zh: 什么都吃；各样食物都吃（不挑食）
entries.en: to eat everything; to eat all kinds of food
entries.notes: L 栏缩写（coṉs ḋs ṿos todos）无法确定展开，H 首字「六」与 M 音 tag 是否对应「逐」存疑，语义仅据 H/M 字形音读推定。

entries.zh: 与任何人同食；不择人共餐
entries.en: to eat with anyone; to eat with whomever one pleases
entries.notes: H「仕食」与 M/R 音读不合，疑形近误录；释义据 L「Comer con quien quisiere」。

entries.zh: 上桌就食；（饭后）小孩上桌吃点剩余的
entries.en: to come to the table to eat; the boy eats a little of it at table afterwards
entries.notes: 封印 H 作「上掉」，而 M「chioṽ t̂」与 R「siáng chō」均指向「上桌」，故从「上桌」；L 栏 gen/gran 不清。

entries.zh: 吃得多；饭量大（大食）；转指食量大的人
entries.en: to eat a lot; to be a big eater; a glutton
to eat one's fill; to eat until full

entries.notes: L「Cometa」义明确，惟 H「光星」非习见彗星称，R 栏较 H 多出一音。

entries.zh: 扫帚星；彗星（旧俗视为灾异之兆）
entries.en: broom star; comet (popularly an omen of disaster)

entries.zh: 解送；送交（把案件或人犯递交上级）
entries.en: to send up, to forward (a case or a prisoner); to commit (a case)
entries.notes: 缩写「g.」（疑 v.g.）及 g/q 字形不清；释义据 L「cometer la causa（交办案件）」与「embiar（送）」合「解」之解送义。

entries.zh: 病号饭；给病人吃的浆粥类流食
entries.en: food for the sick; nourishing gruel or broth
entries.notes: 「漿養」非习见词，据 L「Comida a enfermo」定为病者所食流质。

entries.zh: 疑指未吃完的饭食、剩食
entries.notes: H「金食」与 L「comida q no acabada」不合，M/R 音读 guim 无从定字，语义存疑。

entries.en: a sumptuous feast; a lavish spread
entries.notes: L 栏 cosa/costa 不清，然 H「盛設」与 M「sěng sier」、R「sēng siē」一致。

entries.en: a sumptuous feast; a lavish meal

entries.notes: L 栏残缺（sepa ne almuero 难读），M 中段有划线；据 H「盛餞」与 R「sēng chān」定。

entries.zh: 除灵（丧期结束撤除灵位的仪式）；供在亡者前的饭食
entries.en: the rite of removing the mourning tablet; food set out for the dead
entries.notes: M 整行划除、L「al Cmuerto」不清；据 H「除靈」与丧葬语境定。

entries.en: to feast; to entertain with food and drink
entries.notes: L「Comission Real」（王室委任）与 H「饗」不合，疑错行或一词两义，两存之。
